headlines.title: Mahmoud Khalil credits Palestinian activism for reshaping US politics

headlines.title: Five key takeaways from Israel’s parliamentary elections
headlines.summary: With more than half of votes counted, Netanyahu's bloc holds slight lead over opposition, but shy of majority.

headlines.title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot camps clash over Israel election projections
headlines.summary: Despite narrower exit poll figures, opposition leaders insisted the result was a defeat for the government.

headlines.title: Trump says he's ending restrictions on climate-warming methane from oil drilling
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump said that his administration is "terminating" a Biden-era rule that aimed to cut planet-warming emissions of methane from oil and gas drilling.

headlines.title: Rays stun Brewers with 2-run rally in 12th inning and force World Series Game 5
headlines.summary: Tampa Bay became the fourth team in World Series history to avoid elimination with an extra-inning comeback. Game 5 in the best-of-seven matchup is Wednesday night at Tropicana Field.

headlines.title: U.S. to issue visas to Flávio Bolsonaro as his whereabouts remain unclear
headlines.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for the U.S. amid a money-laundering probe, as Washington agrees to issue visas to him and his family.

headlines.title: Southwest flood damage estimates are hundreds of millions for New Mexico alone
headlines.summary: Intense rainstorms linked to a very active El Niño-driven Pacific hurricane season have left thousands of people in the Four Corners states displaced.

headlines.title: Israel's voter turnout soars as Netanyahu faces a tight election
headlines.summary: Israelis voted in their highest numbers in over two decades in a tense national election to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition.

headlines.title: Defense pact trio pushes for Mideast peace
headlines.summary: KARACHI/CAIRO — Top officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan met Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday in a bid to de-escalate the Middle East conflict, as Yemen's Houthis launched new attacks on Saudi Arabia, and Egypt approved defense support for the Gulf kingdom.

headlines.title: EU's marine biodiversity plans face challenges
headlines.summary: The prospect of potential disputes between European Union member states over fishing rights has been highlighted as a challenge to the bloc's efforts to meet its marine biodiversity protection targets, a report from the European Court of Auditors, or ECA, has warned.

headlines.title: UK budget expected to cut tariffs on some popular grocery items
headlines.summary: The United Kingdom's finance minister, Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey, has revealed measures designed to make living costs more manageable for "millions of working people and families" ahead of the country's first budget under Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Zero tariffs boost South Africa's exports
headlines.summary: South African officials have welcomed the increase in trade with China following the operationalization of China's zero-tariff treatment of the country.

headlines.title: China calls for balanced approach to Iran nuclear issue
headlines.summary: On Oct 27, at a UN Security Council meeting on the Iranian nuclear issue, China's permanent representative to the UN, Fu Cong, said Iran should fulfill its commitment not to develop nuclear weapons, while other parties should respect its right to the peaceful use of nuclear energy. He also urged the US to pledge not to use force against Iran again.

headlines.title: Cyclone Arnab: 609 Andhra schools turn into relief shelters
headlines.summary: Andhra Pradesh has turned 609 schools into Cyclone Arnab relief shelters, flagged 78 buildings at risk of collapse and closed schools in 16 coastal districts.

headlines.title: Rahul Gandhi alleges Tata Group ‘being criminally destroyed’, says will ensure justice for ‘crimes’
headlines.summary: Rahul Gandhi accuses Tata Group of being “criminally destroyed,” vows justice amid internal Tata Sons leadership clash and silent business leaders.

headlines.title: Science is successful only when it benefits society: PM Modi
headlines.summary: PM Modi urges translating science to societal impact, backing ₹1 lakh crore R&D funding to accelerate innovation from lab to market.

headlines.title: Jaishankar to travel to U.S. for G20 Foreign Ministers’ meet, Quad this week
headlines.summary: Jaishankar to attend G20 Foreign Ministers, Quad meetings in Atlanta as prep for upcoming Quad and G20 summits, with potential South Africa exclusion discussion.

headlines.title: INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of CEC to be held at Kharge's residence on October 30
headlines.summary: INDIA bloc schedules a public impeachment of CEC Gyanesh Kumar at Kharge’s residence on Oct 30 ahead of a Nov 1 rally.
